q2.smallest_honest_drive: Two options, neither documented. (a) API_DRIVE: mint an RS256 token in process as the R29 sitting does (sitting_r29.py line 244), then call the four calls of fileAndRequestAnalysis in order with the Bearer (upload, ticket, analysis, record) and read the ticket back. This proves the server chain only: no CHOOSES, no form fill, no page reads. (b) BROWSER_DRIVE: the minted user must hold a page session, that is an HttpOnly refresh_token cookie, which needs a password login through /auth/login (the walker's pattern) or a new cookie path; plus a page driver whose guard admits the upload and submit POSTs. The DONE WHEN names the page, so (b) is the honest drive, and it is not built.
